answer.rationale: Write-path p99 is 5x and isolated to the primary region during peak settlement writes. Rollback is unavailable because the in-flight release is a non-revertible security patch. Circuit breaking risks dropping customer writes, which violates the objective. Read-replica routing historically helped write latency only by shedding dashboard/report reads, which is an unconfirmed fit here. Regional failover is the closest prior (memory_b2) for a primary-region latency incident and is intended, but settlement-value integrity under a live write-heavy failover is uncertain, so verify b2 and the competing write-recovery memory b5 before committing.
